fragrances.name: Terre d'Hermès
fragrances.description: Dry, sunlit bitter orange meets flinty minerality and earthy vetiver. It feels composed and grown-up, like a well-cut linen suit.

fragrances.name: Un Jardin sur le Nil
fragrances.description: Unripe green mango and grapefruit float over a watery lotus heart, with a faint trace of incense underneath. The effect is calm, airy and quietly clever.
cons: Can smell slightly sour to some

fragrances.name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Bright grapefruit settles into smooth incense and sandalwood in a polished citrus-woody blend. It comes across as confident, clean and ready for a boardroom.

fragrances.name: Chance Eau Tendre
fragrances.description: A soft, sheer version of the Chance theme, with juicy quince and grapefruit over a light veil of jasmine and musk. It is cheerful but tidy.

fragrances.name: Infusion d'Iris
fragrances.description: A calm, luminous iris softened by orange blossom and a clean haze of incense. It is understated, thoughtful and very neat.

fragrances.name: L'Homme
fragrances.description: Peppery cardamom and neroli open onto a smooth, lightly soapy iris over quiet amber woods. It reads crisp, laundered and professional without feeling cold.
pros: Easy for any gender to wear
cons: Soapy feel is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Dior Homme Intense
fragrances.description: A velvety, powdery iris wrapped in soft, slightly earthy woods. It is smooth and refined and works best in cooler months.

fragrances.name: Vetiver
fragrances.description: A crisp vetiver lifted by citrus, with a dry backbone of tobacco and pepper. It is timeless, clean-cut and quietly authoritative.
cons: Can feel dated to younger noses

fragrances.name: Encre Noire
fragrances.description: A dark, inky vetiver with a cool cypress edge and soft musky woods. It is moody but tidy, like a crisp charcoal suit.
cons: Can smell too earthy or damp to some

fragrances.name: Grey Vetiver
fragrances.description: Grapefruit and sage brighten a smooth, well-groomed vetiver with a soft dusting of orris. It is restrained and tailored, projecting quiet competence rather than flash.

fragrances.name: Wood Sage & Sea Salt
fragrances.description: A breezy, mineral seaside scent of salty skin and dry sage. It is relaxed, airy and discreet.

fragrances.name: English Pear & Freesia
fragrances.description: Crisp, juicy pear paired with soft freesia over a light musky base. It is bright, tidy and easygoing.

fragrances.name: Another 13
fragrances.description: A hazy, glowing skin scent of musk and ambroxan with a faint hint of pear. It is minimal and magnetic up close.

fragrances.name: Blanche
fragrances.description: Aldehydes, white flowers and soft musk give this a crisp, freshly laundered feel. It is spotless and serene.

fragrances.name: Aqua Universalis
fragrances.description: Lemon and bergamot over a hush of lily of the valley and clean musk. It is bright, spotless and almost weightless on the skin.

fragrances.name: Tam Dao
fragrances.description: A creamy, meditative sandalwood softened with cypress and a hush of musk. It is calm, warm and reflective.
cons: Opening can smell sharp, like pencil shavings

fragrances.name: For Her
fragrances.description: A sensual but refined musk wrapped in soft woods, with a whisper of osmanthus. It sits close to the skin and feels grown-up and elegant.
cons: Musk can be hard to smell on some skins
A little dark for high summer

fragrances.name: CK One
fragrances.description: One of the first mass-market unisex hits: zesty lemon and bergamot over a soft green-tea and musk base. It is relaxed, easygoing and hard to dislike.
cons: Very common and a bit dated

fragrances.name: Pleasures
fragrances.description: A dewy, sheer bouquet of lily, peony and lilac lifted by crisp green leaves and a dash of pink pepper. It is gentle, optimistic and effortless to wear.

fragrances.name: Chloé Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A fresh, powdery rose with peony and a touch of lychee. It is feminine, bright and neatly polished.
pros: Good for the office and weddings
cons: Can smell soapy or sharply powdery

fragrances.name: L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme
fragrances.description: A zesty splash of yuzu over cool watery florals and gently spiced woods. It is breezy, crisp and very much of the clean 90s style.

fragrances.name: Eau Parfumée au Thé Vert
fragrances.description: A crisp, tea-soaked cologne of bergamot and cardamom over quiet florals. It is calming, clean and a little studious.

fragrances.name: Green Tea
fragrances.description: A zippy spritz of lemon and mint over a bright green-tea heart. It is simple, refreshing and pleasantly low-key.

fragrances.name: Iris Poudre
fragrances.description: A soft-focus, aldehydic iris with a warm, cashmere-like musk. It is very elegant, like a silk blouse with pearls.

fragrances.name: Boss Bottled
fragrances.description: A warm, approachable blend of apple and cinnamon over smooth sandalwood. It is friendly, dependable and polished.

fragrances.name: L'Homme
fragrances.description: A clean, gingery citrus-woody scent with a smooth tonka finish. It is modern, gentle and easy to wear at work.

fragrances.name: Colonia
fragrances.description: A sunny, old-world Italian cologne of lemon, bergamot and lavender resting on clean woods. It is dapper, bright and timeless.

fragrances.name: Replica Lazy Sunday Morning
fragrances.description: Pear, a flicker of aldehydes and soft iris melt into a cotton-soft white musk. It is gentle and unhurried, and never gets loud.

fragrances.name: Silver Mountain Water
fragrances.description: Sparkling bergamot and tart blackcurrant sit over a cool green-tea and musk base. It feels crisp, clean-edged and quietly expensive.

fragrances.name: Idôle
fragrances.description: A clean, luminous rose on a veil of white musk. It is fresh, modern and sleek, made for a busy day.
pros: Good for the office and daytime
cons: Some find it sharp or thin
